_about: The AI Hub's catalogue and session tags for Shardfall (docs/AI_HUB.md). scripts/pack_single_html.py --hub writes them into the page's <head>; hub:model and hub:effort come from its --model and --effort, given when the package is made.
name: Shardfall
tagline: A hack-and-slash descent into a shattered world
description: A fast hack-and-slash action RPG: take a hero down through a shattered underworld, cut through monsters, gather loot and grow a passive tree. Up to four players descend together.
controls: WASD to move; mouse to aim; click or right click to attack; Q / E / R / F for skills; Space to dodge; 1 to drink a potion; G to use; Esc for the menu

goals.parallel: Descend as deep as you can before time runs out
goals.ghost: Descend as deep as you can before time runs out
goals.shared-world: Clear the depths together before time runs out

session_howto: WASD move · mouse aim · click, Q, E, R, F skills · Space dodge · 1 potion
